title: FounderX (Founder Institute, San Francisco) — Eric on 'AI companies that do not lose themselves on the way up'
summary: The Founder Institute announces Eric as a speaker at its Global FounderX Conference (Aug 25–27 at STAK Space and Step San Francisco), joining the conversation on the future of startups and what it takes to build AI companies without drifting from the purpose that made them worth building.
blockquote:
At FounderX, Eric joins the conversation on the future of startups and what it takes to build AI companies that do not lose themselves on the way up.

August 25-27, STAK Space and Step San Francisco.
